root_cause: The hide method restores focus to the previously focused element before removing the focus trap listener. When focus moves to the opener, the still-active listener immediately returns focus to the dialog, preventing focus from leaving the dialog.
repair_strategy: Reorder the hide method to remove the focus and keydown listeners before restoring focus, ensuring the focus trap no longer interferes with focus restoration.
expected_accessibility_effect: Focus returns to the opener button after closing the dialog with Escape, preserving logical focus order and meeting WCAG 2.1.1 keyboard accessibility.
functional_risks: Removing listeners too early could theoretically allow focus to escape while the dialog is still visible, but listeners are removed after setting aria-hidden true (visually hiding the dialog) and before focus restoration, minimizing risk.
verification_requirements: Verify that pressing Escape after opening the dialog moves focus to the opener button.
Verify that the dialog's aria-hidden attribute is true after closing.
Verify that Tab key still traps focus within the dialog while it is open.
Verify no JavaScript errors are thrown during open/close cycles.
